name: mermaid
description: Mermaid diagrams drawn in the thread: flowcharts, sequence, class, state, ER, Gantt, mind maps, timelines and more, in bise's look, with pan and zoom, the source, SVG and PNG export, and syntax errors the agent reads back and fixes.

prompts: draw the login flow of this repo as a sequence diagram
make a flowchart of how a task goes from main to landed
a Gantt chart of the launch plan for the next 3 weeks
